title: 林森南路辦公區停車場施工，10 月 5 日至 11 月 30 日暫停開放
summary: 林森南路辦公區地下停車場因防水與照明工程，2026 年 10 月 5 日至 11 月 30 日暫停開放，洽公民眾請改搭大眾運輸或使用鄰近公有停車場。
note: 原型 units 主檔無秘書室，暫由企劃組為權責單位
bodyMarkdown:
林森南路辦公區（臺北市中正區林森南路 6 號）地下停車場進行防水與照明改善工程：

- **施工期間**：2026 年 10 月 5 日至 11 月 30 日
- **影響**：停車場暫停開放，身心障礙者專用車位改設於大門側臨時停車區（需事先來電預約）。
- **建議**：搭乘捷運至臺大醫院站，步行約 5 分鐘。

造成不便，敬請見諒。

en.title: Linsen South Road office car park closed for construction from 5 October to 30 November
en.summary: The underground car park at the Linsen South Road office will be closed from 5 October to 30 November 2026 for waterproofing and lighting works. Visitors are asked to use public transport or nearby public car parks.
en.bodyMarkdown:
The underground car park at the Linsen South Road office (No. 6, Linsen South Road, Zhongzheng District, Taipei City) is undergoing waterproofing and lighting improvements:

- **Construction period**: 5 October to 30 November 2026
- **Impact**: The car park is temporarily closed. Accessible parking spaces are moved to a temporary parking area beside the main entrance (advance booking by phone required).
- **Suggestion**: Take the MRT to NTU Hospital Station and walk about 5 minutes.

We apologise for any inconvenience.
